435:
The check showed that the helmet isn't at
the addresses of the Professor's accomplices.
436:
That leaves the last lead - the cloakroom attendant
Prokhorov.
437:
However, we couldn't check this lead:
Prokhorov didn't show up for the meeting.
438:
He probably suspected something. Quit his job,
hasn't been home.
440:
You - a thousand apologies, and many thanks.
Take off the wig, wash off the tattoos,
441:
go home, see in the New Year. Thank you very much.
- And my boys?
442:
We'll return your charges to where they belong
this very day.
443:
And if the cloakroom man turns up,
might we be needed again?
444:
I didn't want to tell you, but today Bely -
the Professor - escaped from the prison camp.
445:
Unbelievable, but true. It's dangerous for you
to stay looking like this.
446:
Maybe tomorrow? It's New Year's after all, and
in their own way they tried too.
447:
We live out of town, it's unlikely
the Professor can find us.
448:
All right, but don't take a step off the dacha!
Oh, we forwarded your letter
449:
to Sheremetyev's wife, here's her reply.
It's addressed to him.
450:
- You'll have lunch with us on the first, promise?
- We promise!
451:
Pity, such good woman, and father -
a fence, a speculator.
452:
What's all the racket? Who allowed you outside?
- Look who's back... Bad person.
454:
The New Year has come. I wish that in this
new year everything will be new for you.
455:
Anything can happen, but know this:
Wherever you are, wherever I am,
456:
I will always remember you,
I will definitely find you.
457:
- And now... Just a minute...
- Where he go?
458:
Who knows? You can't make anything
out with him now.
459:
What's there to make out? Wherever you are, he says,
I'll find you and slit your throat.
461:
They say he took a razor to Ryaboy's throat - snick, and so long.
- Gone totally wild, jackal.
462:
Who's come to see you? Grandfather Frost
has come, he's brought you presents!
463:
- Fedya, come here. - What did I do?
- Come on, come. Wear them in good health, slippers.
464:
- What the heck do I need them for? I don't even have a home.
- You will, it's all ahead of you.
465:
- And meanwhile they'll come in handy in prison. Wear them.
- All you do is jinx.
466:
This is for you, Vasya... Gavrila Petrovich, this is for you.
- Thank you.
467:
- Pure wool.
- This is for you too.
470:
- Do you have to get drunk as a pig?
- What else is there to do?
471: We could just sit and have a heart-to-heart.
472:
I'm no prosecutor, to have heart-to-hearts with you.
- We could play a game.
473:
Listen to him! Who'd be sucker enough to play with you!
You've got nine aces in your deck.
474: Why does it have to be cards?
475:
Here's a good game - cities.
I say "Moskva",
476:
and you take the last letter, "A" - Astrakhan.
And you take "N" - Novgorod, see?
477: Now you, Fedya, say one on "D".
478:
Vorkuta.
Why? I did time there.
479:
- All right. And you, then, on "A".
- Dzhambul. - What's Dzhambul got to do with it?
480:
Because there it's warm, there my home,
there my mama.
481:
Then let's play this way. I go out, you hide
something, I come back and find it.
482:
- You'd better find the helmet.
- Quiet.
483:
- We hide, and he look through hole?
- Why? You go out and hide it.
484:
And you watch that I don't peek.
- Why me? Anything happens, it's always Fedya!
485:
- I'll rip your jaw off, you little brat!
- Jaw, jaw...
486:
- Professor, were you ever little?
- I was.
487:
- You have papa, mama?
- I did.
488: Why you so mean? Why like a dog?
490:
- Came on his own.
- Ah, you're here too.
491:
I almost went to your place, but I sense
there's an ambush.
492: Mityai, I need to lie low.
495:
- Sorry, doctor, for troubling you for nothing.
- That's all right.
496:
Give him valerian drops, warm tea, and let him sleep.
- Thank you.
497:
- Hurts, Garik?
- It hurts, Vasya. Read it.
499:
"Hello, dear Papa! We found out that
you're in prison
500:
and we were very glad, because we thought
you were dead."
501:
What louse ratted out Khmyr
to Khmyr junior?
502:
"And Mama was glad too, because when
the letter came, she cried
503:
all day, and before she always said you
were a test pilot."
505:
"But I'm glad anyway that you're alive, because
Mama says
506: you're a good man, just weak-willed."
507:
That's right! Weak-willed - swiped the common
money and pinned it on the taxi driver.
508: Scram outta here! I'll knock your horns off, radish!
510:
Shame on you! You're 40 years old,
half your life is already gone.
511:
What's behind you? What's now?
What's ahead?
512:
Darkness, filth and nothing human!
Come to your senses before it's too late. That's my advice.
513:
Hey, Professor, we've got to clear out:
The doctor lady will squeal to the cops.
514:
- She won't squeal. - Why not?
- I, er, took a razor to her throat...
515: she's lying in the well, go and look.
516: How much I have? One year.
517: How much they give for escape? Three!
518:
How much for kindergarten and apartment?
Say ten!
520:
And for lousy 14 years I put up
with this snake?
521:
Who put old woman in well?
You do what you want, I go police.
523:
And you? You'll just put up with him
till you die, is that it?
524:
Vasya, the other day I tell him: I have
a runny nose, and he goes...
525:
Enough, I'm sick of you and your runny nose.
Come here...
527:
- Whatcha doing?
- Going to beat the carpet.
528:
Listen, comrades. Finita la comedia.
First of all, I'm taking this off.
530:
I'll serve my time and that's it. I'll go straight!
Get a job.
531:
- As what? Watchman on my home collective farm.
- Why a watchman?
532:
I can shovel snow, lay bricks, or be
a translator, I know English.
533:
If only we bring the hat too!
Professor is what? A crook.
534:
- Many crooks, only one hat.
- For the helmet they'd cut our sentence.
535: Where'd he put it? We've been everywhere.
536:
Crook! Did I tell you I have a runny nose?
And you: Jaw, jaw.
537:
- Made me dive in this freezing cold!
- When did he make you dive?
538:
When they nabbed us. Remember, he says,
I'm fishing, and you dive.
539:
- Wait, what did he say about fish back then?
- I was fishing in the ice hole,
540:
- and you, he says, Kosoy, can you swim?
- He hid the helmet in the ice hole, that's what!
541:
That's it! He remembered, the bad person!
It's in the ice hole, in Malakhovka!
542:
Why'd you keep quiet? You lout! You could've at least left a note when you hanged yourself.
- Let's go.
543:
- And him?
- Never mind, let them come get him. Carrying a hog like that. Let's go!
545:
- There's nothing there.
- It's there, on the bottom. Someone has to dive.
546:
Why me? Anything happens, it's always Kosoy!
Vasya, tell him to go in himself.
547: I can't! It's cold, I'll get sick.
548:
- A minute ago he was hanging himself, now he's scared of a cold!
- Fitness greetings!
550:
- Where's the boat station here?
- Over there.
551: I'd bump you all off, but I've got no time to bother!
552:
Now there are two of them.
And one more back at the dacha.
554:
- One!
- Well done, Fyodor Petrovich, well done!
555:
- Two.
- The more we turn in, the better.
